params.name: orderingId
params.description:
A value indicating the order of arrival of the Push operation in the Coveo Cloud V2 indexing pipeline. A lower value corresponds to an older operation.  
By default, the service automatically sets this parameter to the current number of milliseconds since Unix Epoch.  
Specifying a custom `orderingId` value is typically not recommended unless you know what you are doing and have a good reason to do so (see [About the orderingId parameter](https://docs.coveo.com/en/147/)).  
**Example:**  `1506700606240`

params.name: sourceId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target Push source (see [Creating a Push Source](https://developers.coveo.com/x/34s9Ag)).  
**Example:** `rp5rxzbdz753uhndklv2ztkfgy-mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: documentId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the item. The Coveo item URI (see [Request parameters](https://docs.coveo.com/en/78/#query-parameters-add-update)).  
**Example:** `file://folder/my-file.html`

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target Coveo Cloud V2 organization.  
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: compressionType
params.description:
The algorithm that was used to compress the item data.  
Specifying a value for this parameter is only necessary when using the `compressedBinaryData` or the `compressedBinaryDataFileId` property to push item data (see [Push source item data](https://docs.coveo.com/en/73/)).  
The possible values are: `Uncompressed`, `ZLib`, `GZip`, `LZMA`, and `Deflate`.  
**Example:** `ZLib`

**Example:** `5`
